newsitem.title: UK: BFI up one in quiet freight market.
newsitem.headline: BFI up one in quiet freight market.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose one point on Monday to 1,284 in quiet conditions due to the holiday in Europe and relative inactivity of Japanese charterers.

Brokers said rumours circulated that 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan was fixed at $21.50 no combo (up 25 cents from last done) but they also reported weaker conditions for panamaxes from Argentina and Brazil.
At 1200 gmt BIFFEX was 10 to 15 points higher and turnover totalled 21 lots.
